HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court seeking the following prayer:
"WHEREFORE, the petitioner respectfully pray that this Hon'ble court be pleased to quash the FIR, complaint, charge sheet and further proceedings as against accused Nos.1, 2, 3, 4 & 5 in CC No.57003/2024 of the respondent police, pending on the file of the XI ACMM at Bangalore for the offence punishable under sections 498A, 504,
506 r/w 34 of Penal Code 1973 and 3 & 4 of D P Act as against these petitioners in the interest of justice and equity."
2.

Heard Sri.V.Lakshmi Kantha Rao, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners,
Sri.K.Nageshwarappa, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri.Naman Vankdari M,
learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. During the pendency of the proceedings before the Family Court, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a compromise by filing Memorandum of Settlement.

They have also filed a Compromise Petition before this Court which reads as follows:
NC: 2026:KHC:6549 HC-KAR "The 1st Petitioner and 2nd Respondent above named states as follows:
1. The Petitioner and Respondent submit that they got married on 09-12-2021.
2.

The Petitioner and Respondent submit that because of incompatibility of temperaments and mis-understanding between the parties they have separated on 09-01-2023 and both Petitioner and respondent herein has filed a case before II ADDL. Family court for dissolution of marriage in OS No: 49/2026.
The Petitioner and Respondent submits that, at the intervention of well- wishers both the parties have come to the conclusion to close the matter on the terms of mediation report.

4. The Respondent No:2 filed a criminal complaint before the 1st respondent in Crime No:
237/2023 for the offences punishable under section 323, 498[A], 504, 506 R/W 34 IPC and the 1st respondent after completion of investigation filed charge sheet against accused No: 1 to 8 for the above offences which is pending on the file of XI ACMM in C.C. No: 57003/2024.

The petitioner and 2nd respondent in mediation have settle the matter and the 2nd respondent has agreed that she will withdraw the criminal case filed against this petitioner and other which is mentioned at para 8 of the mediation report dated 17/12/2025.

sentences.text:
Both the parties have agreed that the divorce can be confirmed and both the parties agreed that they will not interfere with each other's life in future and they have also agreed that they will not file any other civil or criminal case against each other and also under takes that they will not interfere in their personal life in future at any point of time.
6. Both the parties are here by confirm that this compromise petition is entered into between the parties with their own decision and there is no force or coercion by any one to the parties.

WHEREFORE, the Petitioner and Respondent pray that the Hon'ble court be pleased to quash the FIR, complaint NC: 2026:KHC:6549 HC-KAR and charge sheet in Crime No: 237/2023 [C.C. No:
57003/2024] pending on the file of XI ACMM pass necessary orders in view of the above compromise petition, in the interest of equity and justice."
4.

Therefore, in light of the settlement arrived at before the Family Court and also in light of the Compromise Petition entered into between the parties as afore-quoted and the offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings pending against these petitioners in the subject petition.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition is disposed.

ii. Proceedings in C.C.No.57003/2024 pending before the XI ACMM at Bengaluru,
stands quashed, qua the petitioners.
Sd/-
